query:
SELECT week_start AS period, channel AS segment, 100.0 * SUM(unit_price * unit_discount * qty) / NULLIF(SUM(unit_price * qty), 0) AS value
FROM sales_lines
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
summary: Nothing unusual for avg_discount_pct by channel in period 2025-Q2 (threshold 2.5).. No sales at all for: Reseller 2025-04-07, Reseller 2025-04-14, Reseller 2025-04-21, Reseller 2025-05-05, Reseller 2025-05-12, Reseller 2025-05-19, Reseller 2025-05-26, Reseller 2025-06-02
